name: Bound By Rage
game_text:
When you play this condition, you may spot 2 <culture>Dunland</culture> Men to place 2 <culture>Dunland</culture> tokens here.
<phase>Response</phase>: If a <culture>Dunland</culture> Man is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove a <culture>Dunland</culture> token from here to prevent that wound.
